caption: A vibrant bowl of ramen sits on a dark wooden table. Golden broth, marbled pork, and fresh ingredients create a warm, rich, and inviting scene.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table with smooth grain and subtle wear
Marbled chashu pork with rich red and pink streaks
Dark green nori curled at the edges
Golden menma slices with crisp, translucent texture
Orange yolk egg half with cracked shell and soft edges
White bowl with a single black mark near the rim
White ceramic spoon with a slightly chipped edge
